blocks.content: You'll start from a blank dashboard so there's nothing in the way of building your first panel.
Open a new dashboard to give yourself a blank canvas for the panel you're about to build.
blocks.tooltip: Takes you to a blank dashboard ready for its first panel.

blocks.content: With the blank dashboard open, you're ready to add a panel.
Add a Stat panel, choose its visualization, and give it a name you'll recognize later.
Work through the panel editor to pick the **Stat** visualization and title it **CPU usage**.

steps.tooltip: Adds a new, unconfigured panel to the dashboard.
steps.description: Select **Panel** to add a new panel to the dashboard.

steps.tooltip: Opens the panel editor so you can pick a visualization.
steps.description: Select **Configure** to open the panel editor.

steps.tooltip: Switches to the full visualization list.
steps.description: A panel that's never had a visualization chosen opens on **Suggestions**, where Stat isn't listed, so switch to **All visualizations** to search the full set.

steps.tooltip: Filters the list down to matching visualizations.
steps.description: Search for **Stat** to find it quickly.

steps.tooltip: Applies this visualization type to the panel.
steps.description: Select the **Stat** card to apply it.

steps.tooltip: Names the panel so you can recognize it later.
steps.description: Give the panel the title **CPU usage**.

steps.tooltip: Returns to the dashboard with your panel in place.
steps.description: Select **Back to dashboard** to see the panel on the canvas.

blocks.content: The dashboard now has a Stat panel named CPU usage, sitting on the canvas and ready to be promoted to the library.
Turn that panel into a library panel so it's ready to reuse elsewhere.

blocks.title: Save it to the panel library

blocks.content: Open the panel's menu and follow it through to **New library panel** -- the submenu only stays open while your pointer is over it.

steps.tooltip: Reveals the controls that stay hidden until you need them.
steps.description: Hover over the panel's header to reveal its controls.

steps.tooltip: Opens the panel's menu of actions.
This item opens its submenu on hover, not on click.
steps.description: Hover over **More...** to open its submenu.

steps.tooltip: Starts turning this panel into a reusable library panel.
steps.description: Select **New library panel** as soon as the submenu appears.

blocks.content: Name the library panel and create it.

steps.tooltip: Names the library panel that gets saved to your library.
Saves this panel to the library.

blocks.content: The drawer closes and **CPU usage** is now a library panel linked to this dashboard panel -- open the panel's menu again and **New library panel** has been replaced by **Unlink library panel** and **Replace library panel**, which is how you confirm the link without leaving the dashboard. To see it listed alongside your other reusable panels, head to **Dashboards > Library panels**.
